description: Adversarial: the leaf (summarizer) token's scopes are replaced with 'crmx.read', then re-signed, under a root that holds the wildcard 'crm.*'. MUST be rejected: 'crm.*' covers 'crm.' followed by anything, so it reaches crm.read and crm.export but stops at the segment boundary — 'crmx.read' is a different namespace, granted by no ancestor. This vector exists because the boundary is exactly what a prefix match loses: a verifier that strips the '.*' and tests scope.startswith('crm') accepts 'crmx.read', since that string does start with 'crm'. Stripping only the '*' — keeping the dot, and testing startswith('crm.') — is the correct rule (subsumption rule 1).
